title: Finfluencers on TikTok: A Longitudinal Analysis of Content, Engagement, and Disclaimer Practices
subcategory: social media / finance: LDA themes of influencer videos
task: Characterising UK financial-influencer content, engagement, disclaimers and networks
problem: Financial advice from social-media influencers may be unreliable and poorly disclosed.
architecture: LDA topic modelling of video transcripts/descriptions, sentiment analysis of comments, rule-based detection of explicit/weak disclaimers and risk language, and social network analysis of follower graphs.

datasets.name: TikTok
datasets.details: 13,215 videos and 104,097 comments from 71 UK finfluencers (April-September 2024); follow-up 8,565 videos from 59 accounts (October 2025 - March 2026)

metrics: descriptive statistics (topic shares, sentiment, engagement, network measures)
key_results: LDA yields four dominant themes: Entrepreneurship & Side Hustles, Property Investing, Active Trading, Saving & Budgeting.
Only two finfluencers had a profile disclaimer; disclaimers concentrate in trading-related content.
strengths: Longitudinal design with two observation periods from the official TikTok Research API.

limitations.text: UK TikTok creators found by finance keywords only; may not generalise to other platforms or regions.

notes: Raw data not redistributed due to API terms.
